verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is a secrets-scanning tool. Its Enterprise side offers configurable sources, scanners and alert routing, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back those automations is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no versioning, change review or rollback for scan configurations, detectors or alert rules. Keeping a config.yaml under git would be a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
